Title: OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot) Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
## OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot). ## Open-source AI agent that does real things on your machine. OpenClaw, the AI that actually does things. Your personal assistant on any platform. Clears your inbox, sends emails, manages your calendar, and checks you in for flights. All from WhatsApp, Telegram, or any chat app you already use. # OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot) Reviews. ### The community submitted 1 review to tell us what they like about OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot), what OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot) can do better, and more. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot). #### What's great. what won me over is that setup doesn't require a bunch of manual config - it detects existing ChatGPT/Claude keys and you just talk to the agent to configure the rest through chat. running from WhatsApp/Telegram instead of a dedicated app also means I never have to remember it exists, it just lives where I'm already texting. #### What needs improvement. the one thing I'd want clarified before rolling multiplayer out to a team is data scope - when a teammate joins my session, do they see just the output, or the actual file paths and browsing history the agent touched along the way? that boundary isn't obvious yet from the launch materials. #### vs Alternatives. BetterClaw markets itself as "deploy an agent in 60 seconds" which is great if you just want a quick no-code agent running somewhere. OpenClaw felt more like a personal assistant that already lives in the chat apps I use daily, rather than a separate agent I have to go check on - that difference in "where it lives" mattered more to me than raw setup speed.
